question: Is 2026-01-18 through 2026-01-29 unusually rich in precursors of modern JANUS, or did the later Army xTech|Search 10 date typo merely cause retrospective selection of a window that looks meaningful after inspection?

audit_design.primary_rule: Do not score aesthetic resemblance. Count a precursor only when an exact historical source contains a structurally relevant mechanism or representation.
audit_design.major_limitation: The target window was selected after observing the xTech date string; this pass is therefore exploratory and cannot establish statistical anomalousness.

same_period_evidence.message: Upgrade project to version 13.0 with new features

structural_precursors: explicit boundary that system is not therapy/diagnosis/prescription

PRE_CONTROL.demihead_effect: This control falsifies the naive claim that modern JANUS precursor structure first appears only inside the target window.

structural_precursors: living distributed-system metaphors: SCOBY and Physarum
JSON payload graph linked into executable Python

TARGET.distinctive_delta_vs_pre: Representation shifts from primarily internal runtime state to an externalized, inspectable graph of named objects, links and provenance.

janus_meta_registry.notable_provenance_defect: The first commit named janus_meta_registry_v5.5.json contained Markdown META_HISTORY content rather than JSON; the subsequent commit created the actual JSON artifact.
v5_5_delta: birth_canal_patch refined into neural priming, stress-response baselines and sensory calibration
graph declared as a unified concept-spec with major components cross-linked

POST_CONTROL.distinctive_delta_vs_target: Refinement and integration rather than first externalization of the registry representation.

H0_TARGET_UNIQUELY_RICH_IN_ALL_MODERN_PR.reason: PRE_CONTROL already contains substantial modern precursor structure in Janus_Genesis.

H1_TARGET_IS_A_GENERAL_ACTIVITY_SPIKE.reason: The salient change is not activity across all JANUS repositories; Janus_Genesis itself has no commits in the target window.

H2_TARGET_MARKS_A_REPOSITORY_LEVEL_REPRE.reason: Before the target window the strongest evidence is a stateful adaptive runtime; during the target window a separate janus-meta-registry is created with explicit objects, cross-links and provenance; the immediate post-window chiefly refines that registry.

H3_XTECH_DATE_COLLISION_HAS_CAUSAL_OR_PR.reason: The later xTech date typo selected the retrospective window and supplies no independent causal mechanism.

origin_prime_1.old_question: Why does the Army typo point to January 18-29, 2026, when early JANUS artifacts exist there?
origin_prime_1.new_question: Did January 18-29, 2026 mark a representation migration in JANUS from internal adaptive state toward externalized graph memory/provenance, and can that migration be distinguished from ordinary project evolution using blindly selected controls?

discovery_ledger.observation: Strong precursor mechanisms exist before the target window.
The target window contains the creation and rapid materialization of a separate JANUS meta-registry while Janus_Genesis is commit-silent.
The immediate post-window mostly refines the externalized registry and then becomes commit-silent through Feb 10 in the checked repositories.
The most defensible distinctive feature of the target window is representational externalization, not precursor abundance in general.

formalization_ledger.informal_definition: A project changes from storing most adaptive semantics inside executable runtime state to storing named concepts, edges, versions and provenance in an independently inspectable registry that can be linked back into execution.
provisional_observables: ratio of content-bearing registry artifacts to runtime-only artifacts
explicit provenance fields per content-bearing artifact
number of distinct named semantic objects addressable independently of runtime

next_blind_test_preregistration_seed.goal: Test whether the target window is genuinely unusual for representational externalization without reusing xTech-selected boundaries as the only comparison.
next_blind_test_preregistration_seed.blind_control_rule: Choose multiple equal-duration windows from a broader predeclared historical interval without using the xTech typo or knowledge of their contents to select them.
next_blind_test_preregistration_seed.promotion_rule: Current exploratory audit cannot be upgraded to anomalous-window evidence by retroactively applying a metric designed after inspection.

seal.phrase: DEMIHEAD BROKE THE MAGIC CLAIM; THE REPRESENTATION SHIFT REMAINED.
